turns.sql:
WITH dept_emp AS (
        SELECT Ssn, Fname, Minit, Lname, Salary, Dno
        FROM employee
    ),
    dept_stats AS (
        SELECT Dno,
               COUNT(*) AS cnt,
               (COUNT(*) + 1) / 2 AS mid,
               COUNT(*) / 2 AS mid_low
        FROM dept_emp
        GROUP BY Dno
    ),
    dept_median AS (
        SELECT d.Dno,
               CASE
                   WHEN d.cnt % 2 = 1 THEN (
                       SELECT Salary
                       FROM dept_emp e2
                       WHERE e2.Dno = d.Dno
                       ORDER BY Salary
                       LIMIT 1 OFFSET d.mid - 1
                   )
                   ELSE (
                       (SELECT Salary
                        FROM dept_emp e2
                        WHERE e2.Dno = d.Dno
                        ORDER BY Salary
                        LIMIT 1 OFFSET d.mid_low - 1) +
                       (SELECT Salary
                        FROM dept_emp e2
                        WHERE e2.Dno = d.Dno
                        ORDER BY Salary
                        LIMIT 1 OFFSET d.mid_low)
                   ) / 2.0
               END AS median_salary
        FROM dept_stats d
    )
SELECT de.Ssn,
       de.Fname,
       de.Minit,
       de.Lname,
       de.Salary * 0.8 AS Salary_GBP
FROM dept_emp de
JOIN dept_median dm ON de.Dno = dm.Dno
WHERE de.Salary > dm.median_salary;
